auto_profile.premise: In a neon-drenched cyberpunk city, Detective Silas Ray investigates the clean extraction of military-grade neural technology and uncovers a syndicate plot to unleash a virus across the city grid. As the blackout closes in, he must choose between saving Neo-Veridia and sacrificing his own life-supporting neural system.

protagonist.name: Silas Ray
protagonist.archetype: Hard-boiled cyberpunk detective and self-sacrificing hero
protagonist.core_conflict: He is determined to stop the syndicate's neural-tech crimes and citywide virus, even though disabling the relay may stop his own neural heart.

male_lead.name: Silas Ray
male_lead.role: The central male hero and detective; Kira warns him of the danger and pleads with him not to make the fatal sacrifice.

antagonists.name: Vance
antagonists.role: Syndicate leader who profits from black-market neural technology, orders witnesses silenced, and unleashes a virus against the city grid.
